comment: Packages available for remote install. Per-OS install definition: type 1=Windows cmd.exe, 2=Windows PowerShell, 3=Linux/macOS shell. Runs as the agent; commands needing root must include sudo or the agent must run elevated. timeout = seconds.

packages.name: E2E smoke test
packages.description: Harmless smoke test: prints a marker (no system change).

packages.name: htop
packages.description: Interactive process viewer (Debian/Ubuntu/Fedora/Alpine/openSUSE; needs root or sudo).

linux.cmd: (command -v apt-get >/dev/null && sudo -n apt-get install -y htop) || (command -v dnf >/dev/null && sudo -n dnf -y install htop) || (command -v apk >/dev/null && sudo -n apk add htop) || (command -v zypper >/dev/null && sudo -n zypper --non-interactive install htop) || echo 'no supported package manager or no sudo'

packages.name: 7-Zip (Chocolatey)
packages.description: File archiver on Windows via Chocolatey (needs choco; run agent elevated).

packages.name: htop (macOS, Homebrew)
packages.description: Interactive process viewer on macOS via Homebrew (needs brew).
